# Test serving a tree under a URL prefix with -base

cd testdir

md2html -http :8095 -base /docs &
wait-port :8095

# Pages are served under the prefix, so root-absolute links written for
# the published site resolve
curl -s http://localhost:8095/docs/guide
stdout '<h1.*>Guide</h1>'

curl -s http://localhost:8095/docs/
stdout '<h1.*>Welcome</h1>'

# A request outside the prefix redirects into it
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' http://localhost:8095/guide
stdout '307 http://localhost:8095/docs/guide'

# Live reload is reachable at the root, where the rendered pages call it
# by absolute URL. The stream never ends, so the request times out after
# the first event rather than exiting cleanly.
! curl -sN --max-time 1 http://localhost:8095/events
stdout 'data: connected'

-- testdir/index.md --
# Welcome

See the [guide](/docs/guide).

-- testdir/guide.md --
# Guide

Back to the [index](/docs/).
